data: Does the Macro-F1 value for Restaurant decrease as the depth of GCN increases?

The question asks whether the Macro-F1 value for Restaurant decreases as the depth of GCN increases. From the caption, we know that the figure compares different depths of GCN in our model. The y-axis represents the Macro-F1 value, which is relevant to the question.

Looking at the graph, we can see two lines representing the Macro-F1 values for Restaurant and Laptop. The line for Restaurant is shown in blue, and the line for Laptop is shown in green.

Observing the blue line (Restaurant), we can see that it starts at approximately 75% and gradually decreases as the depth of GCN increases. By the end of the graph, the value for Restaurant is around 70%.

Therefore, based on the analysis of the graph, the Macro-F1 value for Restaurant does indeed decrease as the depth of GCN increases.
